concerns.text: FR-008 and SC-005 require that the pipeline validates memory usage stays ≤ 7 GB on a CPU‑only runner, but no task records, measures, or asserts memory consumption. Add a task (e.g., T015) that instruments the full‑pipeline run to capture peak RAM (using `psutil` or similar) and fails if > 7 GB, with verification step checking the logged value.
All FR/SC IDs are referenced by tasks, and no stale tags were found. The only coverage gap is the missing memory‑usage validation for FR‑008 / SC‑005.
